note: SHA-256 fingerprints (of the DER certificate) for the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs disclosed in October 2026. The eight emSign/eMudhra-issued intermediates are cross-verified by two independent sources: the Cisco Talos advisory (https://blog.talosintelligence.com/compromised-intermediate-certificates/), which names each one, and the OpenJDK blocked.certs list for this incident (all eight appear in it). The eight Sectigo/Comodo AAA cross-signs are taken from the same OpenJDK blocked.certs list; each is paired to its parent by list order. OpenJDK's list contains further hashes for this incident that are not identified here; the weak-key detector flags any affected certificate regardless of whether its fingerprint is listed. (CCADB's CSV endpoint was unreachable at the time of writing.)
